metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Theo Fraction
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Theo Fraction takes the role of mathematics teacher. “The third slice is also maths.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: wooden circle divided into three visible fraction wedges.

records.name: Tess Pendulum
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Tess Pendulum takes the role of physics teacher. “It came back exactly on time.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short little tabletop pendulum with one solid swinging bob.

records.name: Len Flask
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Len Flask takes the role of chemistry teacher. “That is the expected color. Probably.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small clean conical glass flask half full of smooth mint liquid.

records.name: Ned Leafcell
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Ned Leafcell takes the role of biology teacher. “The leaf has corridors.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: large leaf and one compact magnifier held against its vein.

records.name: Jade Loop
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Jade Loop takes the role of computer science teacher. “It only runs while I look away.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized board with a chunky closed circuit loop and button.

records.name: Bert Gearmesh
records.biography_en: In The Unstable Lab, Bert Gearmesh takes the role of technology teacher. “They agree when they turn.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two thick wood gears meshed on a tiny handle.
